admission.justification: The obligation is spread over the module that owns the place, the publication and removal callers, the contract and manifest models and the role hand-over, and mcp/tests/test_outside_scratch_root.py pins each part with its own case.

applicability: Ordinary published outside-scratch roots and interrupted .partial- staging directories encountered by cleanup, abandon, finalize and tool-server-start reconciliation.
conditions: Every deletion passes the managed-parent and target-removal guard; a linked, foreign-owned or wrong-mode parent and a symlinked or escaped target are refused.
Ordinary published roots additionally require marker validation, retained path/generation/marker agreement and ended-generation proof.

Interrupted staging requires a real directory and a readable dictionary marker with OUTSIDE_SCRATCH_SCHEMA; its marker may name the final publication path, so ordinary marker-path and ended-generation checks do not apply.
A predecessor's proof is its completion record, or the live address answered cleanup-completed.
An archive, or a worktree group that merely vanished, proves nothing.
A bounded page resumes from the recorded cursor, and a scan that reaches its bound reports it.
exclusions: An active, ambiguous or unproved ordinary published root is reported and left untouched; interrupted staging follows its separately guarded branch.
Ownership is never inferred from a name alone.
A refused parent preserves its entries and reconcile cursor.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_outside_scratch_root.py pins the behaviour with 34 cases on candidate tree f8f92ae2; the leaf's test lane records 5 failed and 6025 passed with no candidate-only failure (Worker A3 report).
The tool server's start now sweeps the outside scratch parent before it serves, and prepares its own process scratch beside it.
The changed lines of this file at candidate tree f8f92ae2 are this leaf's call into, record in, or test of the outside scratch mechanisms; mcp/tests/test_outside_scratch_root.py covers the behaviour.

statement: The reconcile removes an ordinary published root only when its marker agrees with the retained record and that generation is proven ended; it separately removes interrupted .partial- staging directories with readable outside-scratch markers after the shared removal guard. It reports entries refused by its removal or proof checks, walks names lexically in bounded cursor-resumable pages, and is invoked by non-preview cleanup, abandon and finalize and by tool-server start.
